question: Who surrounds Shantyatita Shiva in the bindu covering?
premises: Shantyatita Shiva is surrounded by the kala group beginning with Nivritti.
He is also surrounded by crores of cities of countless Rudras and their powers.
inference: The bindu realm contains an immense retinue organized by kalas and Rudra-shakti hosts.
plain_english: He is surrounded by the retinue of the kala group beginning with Nivritti, and by crores of cities of countless Rudras and their powers.
